items.text: **The volume ring is now the size of the grid ring.** It is drawn as the same 40 px circle as the grid button's ring, centred on the round end of the bar, so it keeps the same gap to the bar's edge as the grid ring does to its top and bottom. On an iPhone it had drawn at about half that size.

**The volume ring has notches, and the speaker sits at its centre.** Eleven notches, one every 10%, run along the ring's inside and light up to the level. The ring, the speaker and the round end of the bar now share one centre: the speaker had sat 3 px left of it.
**The volume ring sits exactly where the grid circle would.** Same distance from the edge of the bar as the grid button's ring, concentric with the rounded end.
**The volume ring is as thin as the ring on the grid button.** Same line weight, so the two read as a pair.

**The volume gauge now hugs the end of the bar and the speaker stays put.** The half ring follows the rounded left end of the bar, inset, instead of pushing the speaker to the right. Arrows above and below the speaker are smaller and sit inside the ring.

**A volume gauge beside the speaker.** A half ring on the left of the speaker shows the master volume all the time, no hold needed: full volume fills the whole half circle, half volume a quarter. An arrow above and below the speaker steps the volume by 5%. Tap or drag on the ring to set it. Tapping the speaker still silences, and holding it still opens the mixer.

**Settings as code, the </> button at the top of Settings.** It writes the look on stage (grid, lines, sounds, mix, tempo, the field) as one line you can share three ways: copy the code, copy a link that opens Battanboo with this look, or download it as a file. Paste a line (or drop a file) into the box and Apply opens it. Save keeps it on this device with a number (Battanboo look 001, 002…) in a row you can tap to open, so a change never overwrites one you already have; Forget removes one after a second tap. Nothing pasted is ever run as code.

**Room mode for the grid, and a speaker line.** The grid now has a **Room**: you sit in the middle, the top rows are in front of you and the bottom rows behind you, left and right as drawn. Farther and behind sounds softer, darker and wetter. (The old Room is now called **Stage**.) The Air pop-up and the cube show what you are hearing, with an ear for two speakers and a speaker for four: "2 speakers", "4 speakers", or "made for 4, you hear 2" when headphones or a Bluetooth box give only two. The grid itself still plays on two outputs; true four-speaker routing of grid notes comes later.
**Copy report, Email report and Clear marks show a green check** when tapped, so you can see it worked.
**The Performance sections list no longer stops with an error.** The Muted list could not open ("Can't find variable: controls", found by the iPad self-test). Fixed in the shared kit.
